decisions.statement: The exports carried are named together in one argument.
A name is parted from the next by a space or by a line's end.
A call naming no export is refused.
A landing path already holding a body is refused rather than written over.
That refusal names the change carrying an export into a body already there.
Every export named is carried by one answer rather than one at a time.
What the division leaves is worked out by the module this change names.
A refusal that module answers is the refusal this change answers.
The file the exports land in is written by the change this change reaches.
The passages the division leaves in every other body are answered as edits here.
No change acting on what a file holds is reached here.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

definition: one code body divided in two, the exports named landing in a file made for them
